milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the cauldron at spawn-relative (6, 1, 4) inside the stone brick shelter and face toward it, modeling 'the player can see the cauldron'. max_distance=10 ensures the player must approach the shelter (spawn is ~7.3 blocks away, so they need to be facing it from nearby rather than just turning at spawn). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is genuinely looking toward the cauldron.
